_comment: Public laws per Congress from sources independent of the Congress.gov law list, measured in docs/LAWS_PREFLIGHT.md section 1. The transform requires each Congress it covers to have exactly this many laws numbered 1..N. Sources: for 93, 94 and 99 the printed citations of every PUBLICLAW granule of the Statutes at Large (GovInfo STATUTE collection) run 1..N; for the others the number of PUBLICLAW granules in the Statutes volumes equals N; for 104, 105, 108 and 118 GovInfo PLAW packages (docClass PUBLIC) also equal N. The 119th is in progress and has no entry.
